overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.shortEffect: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.shortEffect: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

solar-power.name: Solar Power
solar-power.shortEffect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.shortEffect: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

rain-dish.name: Rain Dish
rain-dish.shortEffect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

shield-dust.name: Shield Dust
shield-dust.shortEffect: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.

run-away.name: Run Away
run-away.shortEffect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.shortEffect: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

tinted-lens.name: Tinted Lens
tinted-lens.shortEffect: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.shortEffect: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.shortEffect: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

guts.name: Guts
guts.shortEffect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.shortEffect: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.shortEffect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.shortEffect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

static.name: Static
static.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

lightning-rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning-rod.shortEffect: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

sand-veil.name: Sand Veil
sand-veil.shortEffect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

sand-rush.name: Sand Rush
sand-rush.shortEffect: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

poison-point.name: Poison Point
poison-point.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.shortEffect: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.

sheer-force.name: Sheer Force
sheer-force.shortEffect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

magic-guard.name: Magic Guard
magic-guard.shortEffect: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

friend-guard.name: Friend Guard
friend-guard.shortEffect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.shortEffect: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.shortEffect: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

drought.name: Drought
drought.shortEffect: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.shortEffect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.shortEffect: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.shortEffect: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

stench.name: Stench
stench.shortEffect: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.

dry-skin.name: Dry Skin
dry-skin.shortEffect: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

damp.name: Damp
damp.shortEffect: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

wonder-skin.name: Wonder Skin
wonder-skin.shortEffect: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.

arena-trap.name: Arena Trap
arena-trap.shortEffect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

sand-force.name: Sand Force
sand-force.shortEffect: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.shortEffect: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.

technician.name: Technician
technician.shortEffect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

cloud-nine.name: Cloud Nine
cloud-nine.shortEffect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

anger-point.name: Anger Point
anger-point.shortEffect: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.shortEffect: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

justified.name: Justified
justified.shortEffect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.shortEffect: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.shortEffect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

no-guard.name: No Guard
no-guard.shortEffect: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.shortEffect: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.shortEffect: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.

clear-body.name: Clear Body
clear-body.shortEffect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

liquid-ooze.name: Liquid Ooze
liquid-ooze.shortEffect: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.shortEffect: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.shortEffect: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.shortEffect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

magnet-pull.name: Magnet Pull
magnet-pull.shortEffect: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.shortEffect: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

early-bird.name: Early Bird
early-bird.shortEffect: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

thick-fat.name: Thick Fat
thick-fat.shortEffect: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.shortEffect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

ice-body.name: Ice Body
ice-body.shortEffect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.

sticky-hold.name: Sticky Hold
sticky-hold.shortEffect: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

poison-touch.name: Poison Touch
poison-touch.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

skill-link.name: Skill Link
skill-link.shortEffect: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

cursed-body.name: Cursed Body
cursed-body.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

weak-armor.name: Weak Armor
weak-armor.shortEffect: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

forewarn.name: Forewarn
forewarn.shortEffect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

hyper-cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyper-cutter.shortEffect: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.shortEffect: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.shortEffect: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.shortEffect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.shortEffect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

iron-fist.name: Iron Fist
iron-fist.shortEffect: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

neutralizing-gas.name: Neutralizing Gas
neutralizing-gas.shortEffect: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.

natural-cure.name: Natural Cure
natural-cure.shortEffect: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

serene-grace.name: Serene Grace
serene-grace.shortEffect: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

healer.name: Healer
healer.shortEffect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

leaf-guard.name: Leaf Guard
leaf-guard.shortEffect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.shortEffect: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.

filter.name: Filter
filter.shortEffect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

mold-breaker.name: Mold Breaker
mold-breaker.shortEffect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.shortEffect: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

rattled.name: Rattled
rattled.shortEffect: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.shortEffect: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.shortEffect: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

volt-absorb.name: Volt Absorb
volt-absorb.shortEffect: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

quick-feet.name: Quick Feet
quick-feet.shortEffect: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

trace.name: Trace
trace.shortEffect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

download.name: Download
download.shortEffect: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.shortEffect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

snow-cloak.name: Snow Cloak
snow-cloak.shortEffect: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.

marvel-scale.name: Marvel Scale
marvel-scale.shortEffect: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.shortEffect: Halves damage taken from full HP.

super-luck.name: Super Luck
super-luck.shortEffect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.

magic-bounce.name: Magic Bounce
magic-bounce.shortEffect: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.

plus.name: Plus
plus.shortEffect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

sap-sipper.name: Sap Sipper
sap-sipper.shortEffect: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.shortEffect: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.shortEffect: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.shortEffect: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.

shadow-tag.name: Shadow Tag
shadow-tag.shortEffect: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.shortEffect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.shortEffect: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.

honey-gather.name: Honey Gather
honey-gather.shortEffect: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.

moody.name: Moody
moody.shortEffect: Raises a random stat two stages and lowers another one stage after each turn.

suction-cups.name: Suction Cups
suction-cups.shortEffect: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.

sand-stream.name: Sand Stream
sand-stream.shortEffect: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

wind-rider.name: Wind Rider
wind-rider.shortEffect: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.

poison-heal.name: Poison Heal
poison-heal.shortEffect: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.

wonder-guard.name: Wonder Guard
wonder-guard.shortEffect: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.shortEffect: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.

stall.name: Stall
stall.shortEffect: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.

minus.name: Minus
minus.shortEffect: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

rough-skin.name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.shortEffect: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.

simple.name: Simple
simple.shortEffect: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers. These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.

solid-rock.name: Solid Rock
solid-rock.shortEffect: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

white-smoke.name: White Smoke
white-smoke.shortEffect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

storm-drain.name: Storm Drain
storm-drain.shortEffect: Redirects single-target Water moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.shortEffect: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.

color-change.name: Color Change
color-change.shortEffect: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.

protean.name: Protean
protean.shortEffect: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.

air-lock.name: Air Lock
air-lock.shortEffect: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
